title: Living Well Home Care
description: livingwellhomecare.com Living Well Home Care is a home health agency founded in 2012 in Pearl City, Hawaii, providing skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy and personal care services across all Hawaiian Islands. With approximately 100 to 200 employees including registered nurses, therapists and home health aides, it serves elderly and recovering patients who need hospital-level care at home. It is Medicare certified, Medicaid enrolled and TRICARE approved, accepting most major insurance plans. Its specialized programs cover post-surgical recovery, stroke rehabilitation, heart failure management, diabetes care and palliative support. Revenue is estimated at 5 to 15 million dollars with operations spanning Oahu, Maui, Big Island and Kauai. The company positions itself as a compassionate home care provider delivering clinical excellence in a comfortable home setting.
